description:
The Natural Park Sierra del Guadarrama offers incredible and rugged landscapes of breathtaking beauty.
We will ride a horses on the private land/Ranch belonging to my families for three generations in Madrid Moutains.
Thanks to our riding trails across the Sierra, led by our expert guides, you will discover all those unspoilt settings and enjoy a time of adventure and fun.
The trails were a mix of dirt roads, rocky pathways, and grassy, bushy uphills.
The group are small and we have horses for all kinds of riders from novices to accomplished.

If you don't see a date or time that works Send me a message and I'll check if it is possible
You want make something longer with a picnic ?? Then Check this New Experience "Long Horse Riding Madrid Natural Park"
https://www.airbnb.es/experiences/1254591
Other things to note
Our horses live freedom in the countryside, we have no stables and there are no bathrooms for rider
Please, note you should feel comfortable getting on or off a horse by yourself. Wear comfortable shoes.
Maximum weight to do this experience: 95kg
Minimum two riders
hostdescription:
Although I was born in Madrid I have spent the last 30 years in the mountains, which I have traveled many times on horseback.
I am passionate about my beloved mountains history, tradition,
President of Jarahonda Riding Trails
.-National Riding Monitor
-Tourism Guide
-Assistant Clinical Equestrian
-Farriers by the French and Madrid Equestrian Federation,
-Eventing Rider
locationDescription:
We pick up you in the bus stop of navacerrada. Is only one hour from the center NOTE: don't rely on Google's information, it takes 1 hour by bus to get
After we go to the land to take the horses and prepare them for the the trip
Our horses live freedom in the countryside, we have no stables and there are no bathrooms for riders
Horse riding trails take place at the Madrid Sierra and the Sierra Guadarrama National Park, only 45 Km of Madrid city

reviews.text: Great experience, definitely a must do if your staying in Madrid. We rode horses up the mountain for about 1.5 hours. Magical experience

What a great experience! Was a little nervous signing up since it was my first time riding. But Mariano was such a clear teacher, and his horses were so obedient. Was also greeted with 360 views of the mountains, with Mariano making short pit stops to share stories about some key locations. Mariano was consistently checking in to make sure I was doing ok, which I really appreciated. Thank you Mariano for the amazing time!

At first the plan was to do the longer trip through the mountains as I have experience with horse back riding. Mariano was so smart to cancel this because of bad weather conditions. So for me to still be able to go riding during my stay in the area, I had to compromise with the shorter trip. Nevertheless it was just wonderful! The area he keeps his horses and you get to see on the trip is magnificent! Thank you Mariano to give us the opportunity to see this beautiful place you get to live in every day. It is also suitable for beginners, as the horses do not need a lot of guided tour:) you should only carry long things and not be afraid of a few scratches, as you walk the horses through trail trails, which was really amazing. I recommend it to everyone who loves horses or wants to learn them:)

An unforgettable experience! Mariano's ranch is in a beautiful area and it is incredible how close it is to Madrid, you can get there by car and bus in less than an hour. The whole walk we took was spectacular and we had very interesting conversations along the way; Mariano is super friendly and friendly. The horses looked happy and are free on the property, you can tell they are very well cared for. Regarding prep for the walk, I recommend wearing boots and having a good jacket as temperatures can drop drastically with the elevation. I used a patagonia branded jacket (the ones that are light, with feathers) and I was more than fine. This experience has been a 10/10 and is something we will never forget.

We had a great time with Mariano and his horses, we had no previous experience and everything was excellent. My group was of 3 people and we enjoyed it very much, both the views and the walk and Mariano's company. This was a excellent and authentic experience. We were given very helpful directions to get there by public transportation. Mariano was a great host who made sure we felt comfortable with riding and looked after us during the entire ride, which was through his beautiful property in the mountains.

I thoroughly enjoyed my first time horse back riding on the breathtaking, magical lands passed down through Mariano’s family. 🏇🏞 He picked us up from our bus stop after we got off at the wrong stop. Mariano is great with communication before the experience. He provides very specific instructions of exactly where to get off and get on the bus from Madrid. (We thought we would follow (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps but it’s better to trust his directions and timing ⏱.) He let out all the horses after our ride and let them roam freely. He cracked jokes all throughout our time together. I would definitely come back and bring my friends to experience this tranquility.

Great experience if you have a morning or afternoon available to check out Mariano’s ranch and horse ride. The views are breathtaking. I’ve never rode a horse before and was still was able to ride them, no issues.
A great experience! Mariano was a great host and we had a great time with him. The horses are beautiful and the scenery spectacular. Highly recommended!
The views were absolutely magical!! The horses were quite calm and gave us a really nice ride to the top of the mountains for some gorgeous scenery and a lovely time

The experience was a lot of fun. Communication worked, even if there was a slight language barrier, which is why we misunderstood the meeting point (a bus stop too early). The introduction could have been better to pick up some inexperienced riders and made them more thoughtful.

In addition, we would have liked even more information in general about the area, the nature, the horses, etc., and it was rarely maintained so that a rider could unlock with her slower horse.
Overall, we had fun on the horses in the two hours and I can recommend the experience if you want a change of Madrid, but the experience could be even better.

We absolutely loved our tour of the countryside outside of Madrid w Mariano. The horses roam free on his property when they are not being ridden. If you are staying in Madrid, it’s a one hour bus ride from Moncloa bus station. 5.1 euro each person, each way. One hour each way. It was a journey, but it was worth it.

It was exceptional even for me with zero horse riding experience. Mariano is a great person with positive energy. He explains everything very well. My husband and I love the event and recommend it for sure!

This excursion with the horses was very special to me. I've never had an adventure like that before. 😊 Although I am a beginner in horseback riding, it wasn't a problem because Mariano has horses for beginners as well. Mariano is a very friendly man, he speaks English too.

Where do I even begin? It felt like we have known Mariano for years.... he’s super inviting and sweet. From the moment I bought the package he helped me get to the ranch. My hubby had his GPS on in the bus just to ensure we got off at the right stop (I recommend getting a text and call card while you’re in Spain). My hubby also called Mariano once we got off and he was there within 10 minutes to get us in his cute little ranch truck haha. I told him I was a chicken and needed the slowest nicest horse which he gave me Ofcourse. We were only a group of 4 so it made things easy and intimate and we enjoyed ourselves on the trail. Mariano was literally there the entire time to help if there was an issue. The mountains were breathtaking omg.....like no words!! The weather was also rare today because it was snowing two weeks ago apparently and today was like high 50s with a gorgeous breeze! Mariano and I also talked about fun stuff on the trail and he made it so much fun for us. He even asked us if we wanted to keep going after We were done! Once we were done he took a billion pics of us on the mountain and off lol. He also drove us to the town afterwards (which he didn’t have to do) but he’s that nice. He recommended a yummy place to eat and I had bull for the first time (yum!) the town was filled with locals and there was a Sunday market going on so I highly recommend you go on Sunday so that you can experience the town like we did. I would def recommend and come back because it was an experience of a lifetime!!!! Thank you Mariano :)
